name: Lofoten Islands
about: Summer midnight sun is best for hiking; deep winter brings northern lights and orca season nearby.
overview: Dramatic granite peaks rising straight out of the sea, fishing villages on stilts, and some of the most photographed scenery in Norway.
costOverview: Lofoten runs expensive even by Norwegian standards — a simple bowl of fish soup costs more here than a full meal in most of Europe, though the fish burger at Sakrisøy's famous stand stays affordable.

specialSeasons.text: The midnight sun keeps it light around the clock, good for late-night hiking.
Orcas hunting herring move into nearby fjords, and dark skies bring strong aurora chances.
